h1: The 4 Best Sharp Microwaves of 2026, Ranked & Reviewed
metaDescription: Ranked and reviewed by Primea: four Sharp microwaves, from countertop to over-the-range and drawer models, compared on wattage, capacity and install type.
summary: The Sharp SMC2266KS is our top pick for most kitchens with its 2.2 cu. ft. cavity and 1200W output. The SMC1162KS is the compact value option, the SMD2420MS drawer oven is the premium built-in, and the SMO1759JS is the over-the-range choice.
intro: Sharp sells microwaves in three very different shapes: countertop, over-the-range and built-in drawer. Buyers often pick on looks and discover later that a drawer oven needs cabinetry or an over-range unit needs a wall mount.
We reviewed Sharp's listings and ranked four that cover those shapes. The ranking is based on listed specs only, so check your install details before buying.

products.name: Sharp SMC2266KS 2.2 cu. ft. 1200W Stainless Steel Countertop
products.verdict: The roomiest, most powerful Sharp countertop model.
products.description:
The SMC2266KS is listed at 2.2 cu. ft. and 1200 watts in a stainless steel finish. It is the largest and most powerful countertop Sharp here.

It ranks first because it combines the highest wattage with the biggest cavity, while the SMC1162KS below drops to 1.1 cu. ft. and 1000 watts. The tradeoff is footprint, since this one takes real counter space.

It suits families that heat large plates or batches. The listing gives few extra features, so verify the control layout before buying.
products.idealFor: Families heating large plates and batch meals.

products.name: Sharp SMC1162KS 1.1 cu. ft. 1000W Stainless Steel Countertop
products.verdict: A compact stainless Sharp that handles daily reheating.
products.description:
The SMC1162KS lists 1.1 cu. ft. and 1000 watts with a stainless steel exterior, in the $100 to $200 tier.

It ranks second because it costs less and takes less counter than the SMC2266KS, but gives up 200 watts and half the cavity. That is a fair trade for small households.

It suits dorms and small kitchens. Larger dinner plates may not fit.
products.idealFor: Dorms and small kitchens that need everyday reheating.

products.name: Sharp SMD2420MS 24-Inch Built-In Microwave Drawer Oven
products.verdict: A drawer-style Sharp for under-counter installs.
products.description:
This drawer oven lists 1.2 cu. ft., a touch control panel, sensor cook technology and under-counter installation. It is built to be mounted below the counter line.

It ranks third because it costs in the $500 plus tier and needs cabinetry, yet it gives a clean, accessible build the countertop models cannot. You get easier reach but a bigger bill.

It suits remodels and accessible kitchens. The caveat is professional installation planning.
products.skipIf: You rent or want a plug-and-play unit.

products.name: Sharp SMO1759JS 30 in. 1.7 cu. ft. Smart Over the Range Microwave Oven
products.verdict: A smart 30 inch over-the-range option with 1.7 cu. ft.
products.description:
The SMO1759JS is a 30 inch smart over-the-range microwave with 1.7 cu. ft. of capacity.

It ranks last because the listing gives no price tier or wattage detail, whereas the SMC2266KS lists 1200 watts clearly. You gain a space-saving mount but know less about it.

It suits homeowners replacing a 30 inch over-range unit. Check wattage and venting details before ordering.
products.idealFor: Homeowners replacing a 30 inch over-range microwave.
products.skipIf: You want full wattage details upfront.

whatMatters.detail: Sharp sells countertop, over-the-range and drawer units, and each demands a different space. A drawer oven needs under-counter cabinetry, and an over-range needs a wall mount. Check your kitchen layout before picking a shape.
Higher wattage cooks faster, and a 1000 watt unit takes longer than a 1200 watt one on the same dish. Find the figure in the product title, where Sharp usually prints it.
Interior volume in cubic feet decides which plates fit. Around 1.1 cu. ft. suits small kitchens, while 2.2 cu. ft. fits large dishes. Check the turntable diameter on the listing.
Sensor cook technology adjusts time by detecting steam, which reduces overcooking. It matters if you reheat a variety of foods. Look for it in the feature list.
Stainless steel resists scratches and matches many appliances, though it shows fingerprints. Check the finish in the title, since Sharp sells black and white versions too.

cards.label: Countertop
cards.text: Plug and play, with the SMC2266KS and SMC1162KS in this ranking.

cards.label: Built-in
cards.text: Cleaner look but needs install. The SMD2420MS drawer and SMO1759JS over-range both qualify.

howToChoose.note: Most buyers should default to a countertop Sharp unless they are remodeling.

cards.label: Look for
cards.text: A low or drawer-style opening, easy touch controls and no reaching above the stove.

cards.label: In this ranking
cards.text: The Sharp SMD2420MS drawer oven mounts under the counter with touch controls and sensor cooking.

cards.label: Spend more if
cards.text: You are remodeling and want the Sharp SMD2420MS built-in with sensor cook.

cards.label: Save if
cards.text: You only reheat, in which case the Sharp SMC1162KS is plenty.

faq.q: Does the Sharp drawer oven need a cabinet?
faq.a: Yes. The SMD2420MS is listed for under-counter installation in a 24 inch opening.

faq.q: What is the common Sharp buying mistake?
faq.a: Choosing by finish. Sharp sells the same model in black, white or stainless, so confirm the exact model number.

faq.q: Is the SMC2266KS worth it over the SMC1162KS?
faq.a: If you heat large plates, yes. The 2.2 cu. ft. cavity and 1200 watts are a clear step up from 1.1 cu. ft. and 1000 watts.

faq.q: How do I set up an over-the-range Sharp?
faq.a: Mount it on a bracket above a 30 inch range and plan for a vent. Hire help if unsure.

faq.q: How do I clean a stainless Sharp microwave?
faq.a: Wipe the interior after spills and use a soft cloth on the exterior to avoid scratches.

faq.q: Can I use the SMD2420MS on a countertop?
faq.a: It is built for under-counter installation, so it is not meant for countertop use.

finalTake: The Sharp SMC2266KS is the best all-around Sharp for most kitchens. Pick the SMC1162KS if space is tight, the SMD2420MS for a remodel, and the SMO1759JS if you are replacing an over-range unit.
